description.en: Lightweight rootless Grafana Alloy telemetry and log collector pushing NethServer 8 and customer LAN infrastructure metrics (Proxmox VE, Windows, Linux, SNMP v2c/v3, Syslog) to Central Monitoring Hub over HTTPS.
description.de: Leichtgewichtiger Rootless-Grafana-Alloy-Standortkollektor zum sicheren ausgehenden HTTPS-Push von NethServer-8- und Kunden-LAN-Metriken (Proxmox VE, Windows, Linux, SNMP v2c/v3, Syslog) an den Central Monitoring Hub.
